page.layout: One printed page, one text column with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right. Below the column, a signature mark at left and a catchword at right.

main_text.p: ficere adesse aliquod periculum, adversus quod se licitè tuetur. Defensor enim pro-priæ salutis in nullo peccasse videri potest. Verùm non illel. 3. Cod. Ad l. Cornel. de Sicar. tantum salutis est defensor, qui mortem averrit, sed etiam qui vulnera, qui membri amputationem. Amplius quicunque se vulnerari patitur, nullo modo se tuetur. Quod tamen omni jure potest. Ut si muti-l.45.§.4. D. Ad l. Aquil. lantem occidat, tantum beneficio legis usus fuisse dicatur. Quid quod impune quis furem occidat, cui sine periculo suo parcere non potuit. Ut quil.9. Cod. Ad l. Cornel. de Sicar. mutilantem occidit, ideo excusetur, quod aliter periculum evitare non potuerit. Denique id indistincte permissum cuivis, quod ad tutelam sui corporis fecerit. Verùm non ille tantum qui necare volentem occidit, aliquid fecit ad corpotis tutelam, sed & vo-

page.notes: Running head first letter reads "D:" and is transcribed as "De" with a doubtful reading. The printed "corpotis" in the last line appears to be a misprint for "corporis"; left as printed. The long s has been normalised to s, and "poteft", "adesse", "fuiffe" have been read as potest, adesse, fuisse. The last word of the page is cut at the line end ("vo-") and continues on the next page. The page number and the note references at the right margin were read from the scan with reasonable certainty.
